Notes on arrival checks for an upbeat stint
This page is for you

Arrival checks for pets at Aurelia Skyways

Use this guide to move through arrival checks without delay. The Companion Animal Travel Desk helps travelers keep animals safe, calm, and ready for the next step after landing. If you are already at the skyport, stay close to the welcome team and follow directions at once.

When you reach the check area, keep your documents easy to show and keep the pet secure. The cabin team may need to confirm the animal is fit for travel and that the carrier or crate is closed correctly. If a supervisor asks for a closer look, answer promptly and keep your pet steady.

For reptile travel, follow the handling rules exactly. <<FACT F066>> Bring the animal in a carrier that is clean, locked, and suitable for safe transfer. If any part of the setup looks damaged, report it right away so the team can stop the process before it becomes a problem. <<FACT F060>> Do not try to adjust the crate after staff begin the check unless they ask you to do so.

For rabbit travel, make sure the paperwork is current before you arrive. <<FACT F082>> If the documents are missing or unclear, the desk may hold the animal for review until the issue is fixed. Keep the rabbit in a quiet space and avoid opening the carrier unless a staff member tells you to.

If your pet seems stressed, say so immediately. The supervisors listen carefully when a traveler reports a concern, and the team can slow the process or give more support. Clear packing, clean carriers, and calm handling make arrival checks faster and safer for everyone.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways before you leave the skyport.
